title: Leandro's changing story: underground citadel with stone sarcophagi

tellings.quote: And so initially, he was saying, "Hey, I found this underground citadel, like almost like a temple." And they were in there and they were inside of stone sarcophagi. That was the initial story.

related.note: Same event, Leandro's discovery of the bodies, but this telling says his first version was an underground citadel or temple with stone sarcophagi, not a cave behind a collapsed wall.

plain: A man named Leandro, who says he found strange three-fingered bodies near Nazca in Peru, first said he had found an underground citadel, almost like a temple, with the bodies lying inside stone sarcophagi. Michael Mazzola tells Michels this was Leandro's initial story, which later changed. How the account shifted matters for how far anyone can trust where the bodies came from.
